title: What is HisabDo?
text: What is HisabDo? HisabDo is an offline-first khata and ledger app for Android. It helps users track money given and received, customer balances, and expenses. PDF reports are available for supported records.

title: What is a cash flow statement?
text: What is a cash flow statement? A cash flow statement summarizes money entering and leaving a business during a period. It commonly groups cash flows into operating, investing, and financing activities.

title: How do I export my expenses?
text: How do I export my expenses? HisabDo supports PDF reports for supported records. Official documentation describes reports for transactions, customer balances, and customer activity. The exact steps may depend on the screen and record being viewed. CSV export is not confirmed by the source.

title: What's the difference between profit and cash flow?
text: What's the difference between profit and cash flow? Profit is revenue minus expenses over a period under the applicable accounting rules. Cash flow describes actual cash entering and leaving a business. A business can report a profit while experiencing a cash shortage if customers have not paid.

title: What is profit?
text: What is profit? Profit is the amount remaining after expenses are subtracted from revenue, according to the applicable accounting method.

title: What is revenue?
text: What is revenue? Revenue is the income generated from a business's sales or services before expenses are deducted.

title: What is an expense?
text: What is an expense? An expense is a cost incurred by a business while operating or generating revenue.

title: What is cash flow?
text: What is cash flow? Cash flow is the movement of money into and out of a business during a period.

title: What is the difference between revenue and profit?
text: What is the difference between revenue and profit? Revenue is the income generated before expenses are deducted. Profit is what remains after the relevant expenses are subtracted from revenue.

title: Why can a profitable business have cash-flow problems?
text: Why can a profitable business have cash-flow problems? A business may record revenue before receiving payment from customers. It can therefore report a profit while not having enough available cash to pay its immediate obligations.
